audit.why: Both layers and the packet agree on Katarina 7/7, and the kit supports it: Ziggs has one repositioning tool (Satchel Charge, 20s at rank 1) and no hard CC, against a blink on 12s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Satchel Charge cooldown is stated as 24 seconds in both spikes[0].text and mid. It is 20 seconds at rank 1 and 12 at rank 5.
audit.why: A wrong number on the one cooldown the whole matchup is scheduled around makes every 'commit now' call wrong by four seconds in the player's favour — the worst direction to be wrong in.
audit.corrected: Both corrected to 20 seconds at rank 1, with the maxed value given.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction is never stated: Satchel Charge knocks enemies away, and displacement cancels a channel — so it is the one button in his kit that ends Death Lotus. The page instead calls it only an escape. Two further kit facts are absent: Satchel damage is percent-health, so armour and magic resist do not answer it, and Short Fuse is an auto-attack reset whose wind-up is the tell that his combo has started.
audit.why: enemyKit W carries knockup and percentHealth flags and Riot's text says the explosion knocks enemies away; ownerKit R is a channel that any CC cancels; enemyKit P carries the autoReset flag.
audit.corrected: Stated in breakdown.cooldowns, the Do's and the Don'ts.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT); dosFull[2].d invents a 'fifteen-second' Satchel window.
audit.why: Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1, Hexplosive Minefield a flat 16s at every rank, Bouncing Bomb 6s down to 4s, Mega Inferno Bomb 120/95/70.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d is tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d is tradeBad verbatim (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED), and dontsFull[2].t names spell-shield kits Ziggs does not have. The packet flags six fabricated names: 'Bouncing Blades' for Katarina's Q, 'Bounce Bomb' for Bouncing Bomb, and 'Mega Inferno' for Mega Inferno Bomb.
audit.why: Riot's text gives Katarina's Q no name in the kit file; the enemy names are Bouncing Bomb, Satchel Charge, Hexplosive Minefield and Mega Inferno Bomb.
audit.corrected: All corrected to the kit names or to the mechanic.

edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback escape — he is catchable only while it is down. It governs your forward steps. - E Shunpo (second use) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1, 12s maxed, and it is not just his escape — the knockback ends Death Lotus mid-spin. Draw it before you channel. - Hexplosive Minefield is a flat 16s at every rank: enter from a side angle and it does nothing. - Mega Inferno Bomb is 120s at rank 1 and cannot peel him at melee range.

edits.before: Trade through grounded daggers only
edits.after: Fake the engage to draw the Satchel

edits.before: His knockback escape — he is catchable only while it is down. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Step in, step back, and make him spend it. That is 20 seconds at rank 1 where he cannot reposition and cannot break your channel.

edits.before: Bait his CC before any full string
edits.after: Enter from the side, never the wave

edits.before: Q the bounce, E to the landed dagger, W as you spin out — steel-routed trades his aim can't follow.
edits.after: Hexplosive Minefield only bites if you walk the lane he mined. Blink in on a side angle and his 16-second zone covers empty ground.

edits.before: Ziggs burns Satchel Charge on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Ziggs hops a wall or clears a wave with Satchel — that is a 20-second invitation and the only thing that interrupts your spin.

edits.before: Shunpo into a held stun — ever
edits.after: Channel with the Satchel still held

edits.before: That is Ziggs’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: The blast knocks you away and displacement ends a channel — a full Death Lotus dies to one held W. Confirm it is gone, then spin.

edits.before: Your lotus dies to one interrupt — counting their CC before spinning is the entire skill floor of the champion.
edits.after: He can detonate the Satchel on command, so a predictable landing spot is a knockback waiting to happen. Vary where the steel drops.

edits.before: All-in into spell-shield kits unbroken
edits.after: Answer his damage with resistances

edits.before: Shunpo onto a face with the CC still loaded — Katarina dies to held buttons, not skill, and everyone holding one knows it.
edits.after: Satchel Charge scales off your maximum health, so stacking armour or magic resist does not shrink it. Distance and timing are the answer.

edits.before: Ziggs wins by landing Satchel Charge, denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Ziggs wins by knocking you out of Death Lotus with a held Satchel Charge, then free-sieging the map you never got to enter.

edits.before: Ahead, chain it: zone Ziggs off daggers, lotus every skirmish, and reset through the map — fed Katarina is a weather event.
edits.after: Ahead, take his towers off the board first — sieging is his whole late game. Deny the objectives and a fed Ziggs has nothing to point at.

edits.before: Carry through chain reactions — one kill is three; your job is the first domino and the discipline to wait for it.
edits.after: Carry by removing him from every fight before it starts. He must stand still to throw bombs, and a flank arrives faster than a 120-second R.

edits.before: If Ziggs gets a kill, the lane gets honest — give Satchel Charge extra room and farm it back. Two kills: stop dueling your tilt — farm with Q bounces and stay relevant through reset potential.
edits.after: A fed Ziggs shoves faster and takes plates you cannot answer. Farm outside 850 so Bouncing Bomb has to choose between you and the wave, and come back through the side of the lane rather than the middle of his minefield.

edits.before: You are the cleanup that starts fights: enter on steel, lotus the clump, reset through the kill, and exit through the panic.
edits.after: You end the siege before it opens: ward the flank he stands on, wait for the Satchel to be spent on a wall or a wave, then arrive on top of him.

edits.before: Full combo online means every Bouncing Blades dagger is a kill threat: Shunpo in, Q-W-E through him, and his only answer is Satchel Charge — once W is down (24s early) he is a stationary artillery piece with no peel. Dodge Bounce Bomb minefields by entering from the side, not through the wave.
edits.after: Full combo online means every dagger you land is a kill threat: Shunpo in, Q-W-E through him, and his only answer is Satchel Charge — once W is down (20s at rank 1) he is a stationary artillery piece with no peel. Skip Hexplosive Minefield by entering from the side, not through the wave.

edits.before: Death Lotus point-blank kills him through anything; Mega Inferno Bomb is a long-range zone tool, not a self-peel button. Bait Satchel first with a fake engage, then commit R on the reposition — he has zero mobility left.
edits.after: Death Lotus point-blank kills him, but not through a held Satchel Charge — the knockback ends the channel outright. Bait it with a fake engage first, then commit R once he has spent it and has no mobility left.

edits.before: He becomes a tower-melting siege bot who must stand still to throw bombs — exactly what a 2-item Katarina eats. Flank teamfights, Shunpo past his minefield, and delete him before Mega Inferno lands anywhere useful.
edits.after: He becomes a tower-melting siege bot who must stand still to throw bombs — exactly what a 2-item Katarina eats. Flank teamfights, Shunpo past his minefield, and delete him before Mega Inferno Bomb lands anywhere useful.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 you already threaten him: Bouncing Blades matches his Bounce Bomb chip, and any time he throws Q at the wave you can walk up for a free trade. His passive Short Fuse tower-poke doesn't matter yet; his real weakness is that pre-Satchel he has literally no escape, so a level 2 dagger-Shunpo trade with jungler proximity is winnable. Just don't facetank Q through the minion line — it does full damage on first bounce.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 you already threaten him: your Dagger matches his Bouncing Bomb chip, and any time he throws Q at the wave you can walk up for a free trade. Short Fuse is an auto-attack reset — the wind-up on his basic is the tell that the combo has begun, so step back on the animation, not the cast. His real weakness is that pre-Satchel he has no escape at all, so a level 2 dagger-Shunpo trade with jungler proximity is winnable.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 this lane is yours to run: he has one peel button, Satchel Charge, and it's on a 24-second cooldown — fake an engage to draw it, then hard commit Q-E-W and collect the dagger reset. Hexplosive Minefield only stops you if you Shunpo through it, so always enter from a side angle or directly onto him. At 6, Death Lotus in his face wins every time since Mega Inferno has a huge delay and can't hit someone spinning on top of him; use your shove-and-roam game too, because his slow waveclear pre-Ludens means he can't follow bot without losing plates.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 this lane is yours to run: he has one peel button, Satchel Charge, and it is 20 seconds at rank 1 — fake an engage to draw it, then hard commit Q-E-W and collect the dagger reset. Hexplosive Minefield only stops you if you Shunpo through it, so always enter from a side angle or directly onto him. At 6, Death Lotus in his face wins provided the Satchel is spent — the knockback is the one thing that ends your channel. Shove and roam too: he cannot follow bot without losing plates.

edits.before: Pre-Satchel Ziggs has no escape, so even level 1 dagger trades threaten him while his Q only chips.
edits.after: Before Satchel Charge is ranked he has no escape, so even level 1 dagger trades threaten him while his Q only chips.

edits.before: Death Lotus at point-blank beats Mega Inferno's long delay, so Kat wins the level 6 fight.
edits.after: Death Lotus at point-blank beats Mega Inferno Bomb's long delay, so Kat wins the level 6 fight.

edits.before: His Satchel Charge burned or on cooldown before every commit
edits.after: Satchel Charge spent before you channel — its knockback ends Death Lotus

edits.before: You eating Bounce Bomb poke every time you walk up to a dagger
edits.after: You eating Bouncing Bomb poke every time you walk up to a dagger

notes: Charts already agreed at Katarina 7/7 across both layers and match the packet, so no chart edits were made. Fixed a wrong cooldown that the page repeated twice: Satchel Charge is 20 seconds at rank 1 (12 maxed), not 24 — the page's core 'commit now' advice was scheduled off a number four seconds too long. Also corrected the invented 'fifteen-second' Satchel window in dosFull[2].d. The largest gap was point 4: Satchel Charge knocks enemies away, displacement cancels a channel, and Death Lotus is a channel — so it is the one button in his kit that stops your ultimate, and the page described it only as an escape. Its percent-health damage (armour and MR do not help) and Short Fuse's auto-reset tell are now stated too; all three came from the missingInteractions list and are supported by Riot's own text, not just derived flags. Killed the fabricated names the packet flagged: 'Bouncing Blades' (Katarina's Q has no name in Riot's kit text — I wrote the mechanic), 'Bounce Bomb' (Bouncing Bomb) and 'Mega Inferno' (Mega Inferno Bomb). Unverified and left alone: the '1200 units back' figure in late and the item names Ludens, Gunblade and Nashor's in whys[5] and spikes[2] — neither ranges of that kind nor item data are in the kits.
